messages:
ava-peopleops: Hey folks — live Q&A from today's All-Hands focused on remote/hybrid & office ops. Drop any follow-ups here and we'll answer in real time. :wave: Please include your team and location if it matters.

kai-engineering: Thanks! Quick one — if I choose to come into the SF office 2 days/week, do I need to reserve a desk each day or is hoteling automatic?

tom-facilities: You should reserve via the DeskBook app for now. We roll out auto-hotel in June for SF/NYC. For this quarter please reserve at least 24h in advance to guarantee power/monitor.

kai-engineering: Awesome, thanks. Any plans for a grace policy if someone shows up without a booking?

tom-facilities: Small grace window (2 hours) if capacity allows, but don't rely on it during full weeks. We'll post a short FAQ.

mike-cto: To add — team leads can request a 5-desk block for focused sprints (1-week min). Talk to People Ops and Facilities; we can approve on a case-by-case.

ava-peopleops: Correct. Submit requests to #people-ops and cc your manager. We'll confirm within 48h.

liam-finance: Note re: travel expense policy — in-person offsite flights should be economy unless pre-approved. We cover reasonable hotel and a daily meal stipend (per policy doc). If you need an upgrade for medical reasons, ping finance@redwood.

kai-engineering: Good to know. Are family travel or childcare costs reimbursable for offsites?

riya-peopleops: Short answer: childcare support is available as a stipend in special circumstances (primary caregiver attending a mandatory offsite). Family airfare is not reimbursed. Please file requests before booking so we can budget.

julia-hr: We also provide a small childcare referral list and marketplace credits for full-week retreats — details will be in the offsite playbook.

ava-peopleops: On visas & international travel: Redwood will help with invitation letters and one-time processing allowances for employees traveling from APAC/EU to US offsites. Reach out to people-ops at least 6 weeks before travel.

kai-engineering: Thanks — will there be support for remote employees on visa waitlists (e.g., deferred attendance if visa not approved)?

mike-cto: Yes, teams should plan asynchronous participation. We'll open a virtual pass for every offsite session and record critical workshops. Physical presence is recommended but not mandatory unless explicitly noted in invites.

ava-peopleops: Question on monthly office stipends: confirm — will we continue $150/month for home office setup for remote-first folks?

liam-finance: Policy stays the same for now. One-time additional grants for larger setups (standing desks, monitors) are still available via People Ops approval.

kai-engineering: One more — what's the approval flow for an ad-hoc team offsite (2-3 days)?

riya-peopleops: Submit the offsite form (link in pinned docs) with dates, headcount, estimated budget, and objectives. People Ops + Finance triage within 5 business days. If it's under $5k, we try to fast-track.

ava-peopleops: Posting the offsite playbook link: https://redwood.company/docs/offsite-playbook (will add to the wiki shortly).

allhands-bot: Link posted in #people-ops: Offsite playbook (v1.2) by ava-peopleops — https://redwood.company/docs/offsite-playbook

kai-engineering: Thanks all — super helpful. I'll reserve desks for next week and submit an ad-hoc offsite request for August.

mike-cto: If any leadership Qs come up post-thread, ping me directly. Appreciate the engagement. :heart:

ava-peopleops: We'll consolidate answers and update the FAQ doc by EOD tomorrow. If you asked a question and need a private follow-up, DM me. Thanks!
